$comment: Image templates: the compositions of the Figma page "8. Brand assets" (file Qx2i6GhXZD1V4O7RE7hYQi) and the Open Graph and story cards derived from them, drawn as the site draws (its type steps, colors, cards, buttons, texture and light images; layouts.mjs says how). layouts.mjs beside this file places them. The first size is the template's own frame; the others are the same layout re-flowed. Slots hold sample copy, drawn only with --sample ({domain} and {tagline} come from brand.json); the address (url) is always drawn, and every other slot only when it is passed. `required` slots must be passed. Pictures fill the photo slots in order and repeat when there are fewer. Third-party pictures and real names from the Figma are never shipped.
